page: Microsoft Azure E128s_v7 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the Esv7 family. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 480 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage is bundled with this instance, though it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile. While single-core stress-ng CPU performance sits in the average tier, multi-core CPU performance reaches the top 10% tier with a score of 126826.65. This multi-threaded strength is mirrored in bzip3 decompression, which achieves a top-tier 704.78 GB/sec. Cryptographic and vector execution capabilities are also strong, with Passmark CPU encryption and extended instruction tests both ranking in the top 10%. However, the Passmark memory score is positioned in the average tier.

The server demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations and high-throughput web serving, with Redis SET operations reaching 189.85 million operations per second and static web serving throughput measured at 165.05 GB/sec. For artificial intelligence workloads, the CPU-based LLM inference shows strong prompt processing speeds for medium and large models, though text generation speeds remain average. Given the high memory density and multi-core processing power, this instance is suited for memory-intensive enterprise databases, large-scale data processing, and multi-threaded computational workloads that do not require local NVMe storage.
